CustomField.description: Apex class implementing IXLSXRowHandler that turns parsed rows into an in-memory result (e.g. SObjectCreatorRowHandler, AggregateRowHandler, or a custom class). This is a distinct role from Result_Handler_Class__c: the row handler builds the result, the result handler persists it. Both must be set independently - a single class is not assumed to implement both interfaces.
CustomField.label: Row Handler Class
